# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands filtering, culling, and overdraw APIs. It adds fast paint bounds, modern image-filter composition, and overdraw visualization while restoring small-blur performance. This release also completes the v4 deprecation pass, so review the breaking changes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now compile errors** — Legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors, run-buffer span methods, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality are now error-obsolete. Use the constructors without sampleCount, the Glyphs or Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions instead. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive integration is no longer included** — The SkiaSharp NuGet no longer embeds the deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension. Remove dependencies on that extension or provide a separate notebook rendering integration when upgrading. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Moves the bundled rendering engine from m148 to m150 and includes an Apple typeface synchronization fix from the m150 servicing branch. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **Fast paint bounds support quick-reject culling** — SKPaint.GetFastBounds computes conservative paint bounds and reports when they are unavailable, completing the culling pattern with SKCanvas.QuickReject. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes** — SKImageFilter.CreateCrop restricts filter output with tile-mode control, while CreateEmpty provides an explicit transparent-black node for composition chains. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))
- **Overdraw counts can be visualized** — SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps SKOverdrawCanvas counts through a six-color palette for rendering performance diagnostics. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small raster blurs regain their faster path** — Native builds avoid the slow raster-pipeline Gaussian path for small-sigma 8888 image blurs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Surface canvas access is cached** — Repeated SKSurface.Canvas access reuses the managed wrapper and recreates it if a consumer explicitly disposes the surface-owned canvas. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with shaping, COLR v1, glyph-extents, and subsetting fixes.
